items.title: Serum Mycophenolic Acid Levels and Infection Risk in Myasthenia Gravis.
items.authors: Gyeong Mo Sohn, Kyong Jin Shin
items.abstract: Evidence linking serum mycophenolic acid (MPA) concentrations with safety outcomes in myasthenia gravis (MG) is limited. We evaluated whether single serum MPA concentrations were associated with clinically documented infection. This retrospective study included acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive MG patients treated with mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) for at least 1 year who had MPA and mycophenolic acid glucuronide (MPAG) measurement with same-day complete blood count testing. Exact sampling time relative to MMF dosing was not uniformly documented; therefore, values were analyzed as single serum concentrations rather than confirmed trough levels. Among 112 MMF-treated patients, 60 had MPA/MPAG measurement, and 10 had recent infection. Serum MPA concentration correlated strongly and positively with MPAG concentration (r = 0.717) and moderately and inversely with lymphocyte count (r = -0.406). Infection occurred in 0/18 low, 2/24 intermediate, and 8/18 high MPA concentration groups. Patients with infection had higher MPA concentration (median 6.15 vs. 1.80 μg/mL; Bonferroni-adjusted p = 0.032) and higher MPA concentration per prescribed MMF dose. Higher single serum MPA concentrations were associated with recent infection. Prospective controlled studies including patients not treated with MMF are needed.
items.zhSummary: 本研究回顾性分析了接受霉酚酸酯治疗且至少使用1年的抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性重症肌无力患者血清霉酚酸(MPA)浓度与感染风险的关联。60名患者进行了MPA及其代谢物MPAG检测，10例患者近期出现感染。结果显示血清MPA浓度与MPAG浓度正相关，与淋巴细胞计数负相关。感染发生主要集中在MPA高浓度组，感染患者的MPA中位浓度显著高于无感染者。因采样时间未统一，MPA水平为单次血清浓度，研究需前瞻性验证及对照组研究支持。
keyPoints: 血清MPA浓度与MPAG浓度呈强正相关。
MPA浓度与淋巴细胞计数呈中度负相关。
高血清MPA浓度患者感染风险较高。
需前瞻性研究验证血清MPA与感染关联。

intelligence.population: 抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性重症肌无力患者，接受霉酚酸酯至少1年治疗
intelligence.keyFinding: 高单次血清MPA浓度组感染发生率显著升高（高浓度组感染8/18，低浓度组感染0/18），感染患者MPA中位浓度6.15 μg/mL高于无感染者1.80 μg/mL
intelligence.clinicalImplication: MPA血药浓度监测可能有助于评估霉酚酸酯治疗中感染风险，但因本研究为回顾性且采样时间不统一，尚不足以指导临床调整用药
intelligence.reviewFocus: 重点关注采样时间未统一对MPA浓度解读的影响，感染定义及MG患者的特异性，强调未来需前瞻性和包含非MMF患者的对照研究

items.title: The effect of FcRn inhibition on overlapping autoimmune comorbidity in AChR-seropositive generalized myasthenia gravis.
items.authors: Vincenzo Di Stefano, Nicasio Rini, Sofia Campo, Flora D'Amico, Aurora Meli, Simona Maccora
items.abstract: Generalized Myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction caused by IgG autoantibodies against antigens in the postsynaptic cleft. This study aimed to assess the real-world effectiveness and safety of Efgartigimod (EFG) in AChR-positive gMG with overlapping autoimmune comorbidity. EFG was administered as 4 consecutive weekly infusions or injections. Myasthenia Gravis Activity of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Myasthenia Gravis quantitative (QMG) scales were administered at baseline and after 4 weeks. Clinical data on autoimmune comorbidities and prednisone use were collected. 35 patients (20 women, mean age 53.6 years) received EFG, with a significant and clinical improvement in both MG-ADL and QMG scores. MG-ADL responder rate (MG-ADL reduction≥2) was 79%, while 68% on QMG (QMG reduction≥3); Minimal symptoms expression was reached in 4 patients, with a mean reduction in daily prednisone dose of 8 mg. Overlapping autoimmune comorbidity was reported in 12 gMG patients (34%). gMG patients with Stiff-Person syndrome, type 1 Diabetes and Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome benefited more from EFG with a higher reduction on MG-ADL. Overlapping autoimmune comorbidity is not rare. EFG demonstrated a meaningful clinical benefit in patients with AChR-positive gMG with overlapping IgG-mediated disorders.
items.zhSummary: 本研究评估了FcRn抑制剂Efgartigimod（EFG）在抗AChR阳性广泛性重症肌无力（gMG）合并重叠自身免疫疾病患者中的实际疗效和安全性。35例患者接受4周EFG治疗，结果显示MG-ADL和QMG评分显著改善，MG-ADL应答率为79%，QMG应答率为68%，部分患者每日用泼尼松剂量减少。34%的患者存在重叠自身免疫病，伴硬皮综合征、1型糖尿病及Lambert-Eaton综合征者获益更明显。研究提示EFG在该患者群体中具有临床获益，但摘要未报告详细安全性数据及长期疗效。
keyPoints: EFG治疗显著改善AChR阳性gMG患者的MG-ADL和QMG评分
79%的患者MG-ADL评分下降≥2，68%患者QMG评分下降≥3
34%的gMG患者合并其他自身免疫疾病，部分亚组获益更显著
治疗期间平均每日泼尼松剂量减少8 mg

intelligence.population: 抗AChR阳性的广泛性重症肌无力患者，部分伴重叠自身免疫疾病
intelligence.keyFinding: EFG在AChR阳性gMG患者中改善临床评分，且合并自身免疫病者疗效明显
intelligence.clinicalImplication: EFG可能为合并重叠自身免疫病的AChR阳性gMG患者提供临床获益，支持其在这一复杂患者群中的应用价值
intelligence.reviewFocus: 关注EFG对评分终点的影响，重叠自身免疫病患者的亚组疗效及激素剂量变化，安全性未详述

items.title: When Weakness Persists Beyond Its Apparent Cause: A Case Report of Myasthenia Gravis.
items.authors: Noor Ehsan, Hateem Ahmed, Mahnoor Iqbal, Maryam Arshad, Muhammad Imran
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction characterised by fluctuating, fatigable skeletal muscle weakness. Its overlap with reversible causes of weakness such as hypokalemia can easily delay recognition. We report the case of a 40-year-old man who presented with one week of profuse diarrhea and vomiting, along with two days of generalized limb weakness. Investigations revealed hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, and his limb weakness partially improved after fluid and electrolyte correction, which raised suspicion of an additional underlying cause contributing to the persistent weakness. He was noted to have bilateral ptosis, and further history uncovered three months of fatigable weakness that worsened towards the end of the day, with slurred nasal speech, difficulty chewing, and nasal regurgitation. Examination showed a positive curtain sign, bilateral ptosis that improved with ice pack test, and fatigable proximal limb weakness with preserved reflexes. Anti-acetylcholine receptor antibodies were strongly positive, and contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) scan of the chest revealed the presence of thymoma in the anterior mediastinum. He responded well to pyridostigmine and oral prednisone. Thymectomy was subsequently planned. This case is a reminder that weakness outlasting its apparent cause warrants a neurological evaluation, since a concurrent electrolyte disturbance can readily mask an underlying myasthenic process.
items.zhSummary: 本文报道一例40岁男性患者因腹泻、呕吐及肢体无力就诊，初步诊断为低钾血症和低镁血症，电解质纠正后肢体无力部分缓解。进一步检查发现双侧眼睑下垂及疲劳性肌无力症状，抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体强阳性，胸部CT显示胸腺瘤。患者对吡啶斯的明和泼尼松治疗反应良好，计划行胸腺切除。该病例提示伴随电解质异常时，持续无力应警惕重症肌无力可能，及时神经系统评估有助明确诊断。
keyPoints: MG表现为波动性、易疲劳的骨骼肌无力
低钾血症可掩盖MG诊断，延误识别
抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性和胸腺瘤支持MG诊断
吡啶斯的明和泼尼松治疗有效，计划胸腺切除

intelligence.population: 一名40岁男性患者，表现为持续性肢体无力伴低钾血症，最终诊断为重症肌无力
intelligence.keyFinding: 持续性肌无力不仅由电解质紊乱引起，还存在重症肌无力病理过程；抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体强阳性，胸腺瘤被发现
intelligence.clinicalImplication: 在电解质异常病因纠正后无力未完全缓解时，应考虑MG诊断，及时神经系统评估和抗体检测有助明确病因及治疗方案
intelligence.reviewFocus: 病例详细描述诊断线索和治疗反应，提醒临床对伴随电解质异常患者的MG识别，需关注临床症状和辅助检查

items.title: Therapeutic Plasma Exchange in Pediatric Patients: A Multi-Institutional Landscape Analysis.
items.abstract: Pediatric evidence for therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) is largely small, single-center cohorts; there is no prior large-scale age-stratified outcomes assessment. Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network, we identified 3744 patients ≤ 17 years old undergoing an index TPE procedure, stratified into four age groups (≤ 1, 2-5, 6-12, and 13-17 years). ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes recorded 30 days prior to the index procedure were mapped to American Society for Apheresis Categories I-III indications; three high-prevalence nonspecific codes were tracked separately. All-cause mortality at 30 days, 90 days, and 1 year was assessed. All-cause mortality decreased with increasing age at every time window: 30-day mortality ranged from 16.8% (≤ 1 year) to 4.3% (13-17 years, p < 0.0001). Infant mortality risk was concentrated disproportionately in the first 90 days postprocedure. Sex distribution shifted from a slight male predominance in infancy and early childhood (55%-56% male) to a female predominance in adolescence (55% female, p < 0.0001). Leading specific indications were autoimmune encephalitis (10%), sepsis with multiorgan failure (9%), renal transplant rejection (6%), acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (5%), Guillain-Barré syndrome (5%), and myasthenia gravis (4%); nonspecific diagnosis codes were each individually more prevalent than any single ASFA-mapped indication. This is the first large-scale, age-stratified, multi-institutional characterization of pediatric TPE. We identified an inverse relationship between age and all-cause mortality, a sex-distribution shift in adolescence, and an indication landscape dominated by nonspecific diagnosis codes. These findings offer age-stratified benchmarks for clinical counseling and hypothesis generation.
items.zhSummary: 本研究基于TriNetX美国协作网络大数据，纳入3744例17岁及以下接受首次治疗性血浆置换（TPE）的儿童患者，按照年龄分为四组，分析了30天前的诊断及不同时间窗的总死亡率。结果显示总死亡率随年龄增大显著下降，1岁以内患儿30天死亡率最高（16.8%），且死亡风险多集中于术后90天内。性别分布由婴幼儿期男性略多转为青春期女性占优。主要适应症包括自身免疫性脑炎、脓毒症多器官功能衰竭、肾移植排斥、急性播散性脑脊髓炎、格林-巴利综合征及重症肌无力，但普遍存在大量非特异性诊断编码。该研究首次大规模、多机构、年龄分层描述了儿科TPE的使用情况与结局，为临床咨询和未来研究提供了基准。摘要未涉及具体治疗效果和安全性细节。
keyPoints: 使用美国多机构数据库分析3744名17岁以下接受TPE儿童
30天至1年死亡率随年龄增长显著降低，≤1岁死亡率最高
青春期性别比例由男多转为女多，主要适应症多为自身免疫和感染相关
大量非特异性诊断编码普遍存在，反映临床适应症复杂

intelligence.studyType: 多机构回顾性队列研究
intelligence.population: 17岁及以下接受首次治疗性血浆置换的儿童患者
intelligence.keyFinding: 年龄与全因死亡率呈负相关，婴幼儿死亡率最高；青春期性别分布由男性优势转为女性优势；主要适应症包括自身免疫性脑炎、脓毒症多器官衰竭等
intelligence.clinicalImplication: 为儿科TPE提供年龄分层的基线数据，有助于临床风险评估和咨询，对重症肌无力等自身免疫疾病的TPE应用具有间接参考价值
intelligence.reviewFocus: 应重点关注研究设计和年龄分层是否合理，死亡率评估的恰当性，诊断分类及非特异性编码的影响，以及是否有MG患者的具体描述

items.title: Autonomic dysfunction and its association with sexual dysfunction in myasthenia gravis.
items.journal: Clinical autonomic research : official journal of the Clinical Autonomic Research Society
items.authors: Cagla Tomris, Ayse Caglar Sarilar, Muhammed Ali Tomris, Ayten Ekinci, Metin Unlu
items.abstract: Autonomic dysfunction has been reported in myasthenia gravis (MG); however, its clinical relevance and relationship with sexual dysfunction (SD) remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate autonomic dysfunction in MG and to investigate its association with SD using objective autonomic tests. A total of 44 patients with MG and 50 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HCs) were included. Autonomic function was assessed with the Composite Autonomic Symptom Score-31 (COMPASS-31), sympathetic skin response (SSR), and R-R interval variability (RRIV). Ocular autonomic involvement was evaluated using the Schirmer test, noninvasive tear break-up time, pupillometry, and corneal confocal microscopy. Sexual function was assessed using the Female Sexual Function Index, International Index of Erectile Function, and Premature Ejaculation Profile. Depression and anxiety were evaluated with the Beck Inventories. Patients with MG showed prolonged SSR latencies, reduced amplitudes, and lower RRIV than HCs (p < 0.05). COMPASS-31 total scores were higher, especially in vasomotor, secretomotor, gastrointestinal, and bladder domains. Corneal nerve fiber density, length, and branching were significantly reduced in patients with MG (p < 0.05). SD scores were significantly worse and correlated with selected autonomic measures. After adjustment for age, depression, and anxiety, reduced corneal nerve fiber parameters were independently associated with SD. In male patients, RRIV during hyperventilation and gastrointestinal autonomic symptom burden were associated with ejaculatory function. Patients with MG exhibit evidence of autonomic dysfunction based on objective autonomic assessments. SD is common in patients with MG and appears to be associated with autonomic dysfunction beyond psychosocial factors alone.
items.zhSummary: 本研究采用客观自主神经功能测试评估了重症肌无力（MG）患者的自主神经功能及其与性功能障碍（SD）的关联。纳入44例MG患者和50名匹配的健康对照，通过自主神经症状量表、交感皮肤反应、心率变异性及眼部自主神经检查等多种指标进行评估。结果显示MG患者的自主神经功能存在明显异常，性功能评分较差且与自主神经功能指标相关，调整心理因素后，角膜神经纤维参数与性功能障碍独立相关。研究表明MG患者存在自主神经功能障碍，且性功能障碍可能与其相关，但因样本量有限，仍需进一步研究验证。
keyPoints: MG患者表现出自主神经功能显著异常
性功能障碍在MG患者中较常见且与自主神经功能相关
角膜神经纤维减少独立关联性功能障碍
心理因素调整后仍见自主神经功能与性功能关联

intelligence.population: 重症肌无力患者及年龄性别匹配健康对照
intelligence.keyFinding: MG患者的自主神经功能指标异常（如SSR潜伏期延长、RRIV降低），性功能障碍与角膜神经纤维减少独立相关
intelligence.clinicalImplication: 提示MG患者的自主神经功能障碍可能是性功能障碍的重要影响因素，有助于临床评估和综合管理
intelligence.reviewFocus: 需关注研究设计、性功能评估工具、精神心理因素控制及各自主神经功能检测指标的敏感性和特异性

items.title: Suspected Bulbar-Predominant Myasthenia Gravis Exacerbation in an Older Adult With Respiratory Deterioration and Silent Aspiration: A Case Report.
items.authors: Hazim I Al Sane, Assim I Al Sane, Riman H Wahidi, Derick G Panackal, Muhammad A Shahzad
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction characterized by fluctuating skeletal muscle weakness. Bulbar-predominant exacerbations may be difficult to recognize in older adults with multiple comorbidities, particularly when respiratory deterioration is initially attributed to cardiopulmonary disease. We report the case of an 83-year-old woman with generalized acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive MG, dementia with behavioral disturbance, moderate chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), chronic kidney disease, and previous deep vein thrombosis who was admitted to a psychiatric unit because of worsening paranoia and suspected delusions. During hospitalization, she developed progressive hypoxemia requiring transfer to the medical ward. Initial evaluation considered pulmonary infection, aspiration-related complications, and COPD exacerbation. Neurological examination subsequently demonstrated new predominantly facial and bulbar weakness with preserved limb strength, accompanied by progressive dysphagia and impaired secretion clearance. Videofluoroscopic swallow study demonstrated significant silent aspiration of thin and mildly thickened liquids; however, the etiology of the dysphagia and aspiration remained potentially multifactorial. Serial arterial blood gases demonstrated persistent hypercapnia; however, stable PaCO₂ values, preserved pH, markedly elevated bicarbonate, and positive base excess suggested a substantial chronic hypercapnic component with concomitant metabolic alkalosis, with underlying COPD representing an important potential contributor. In the context of known generalized MG and newly documented facial and bulbar dysfunction, a suspected bulbar-predominant myasthenic exacerbation was considered a potentially important contributor within a multifactorial respiratory deterioration rather than the sole cause. She was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin and escalation of corticosteroid therapy. Although her respiratory status stabilized, persistent bulbar dysfunction, dysphagia, and frailty remained, and following goals-of-care discussions, the family elected hospice care. This case emphasizes the diagnostic complexity of respiratory deterioration in older patients with MG and the importance of recognizing new bulbar dysfunction while carefully considering competing pulmonary, aspiration-related, cardiogenic, and functional contributors.
items.zhSummary: 本病例报告描述一位83岁合并多种疾病的肌无力（MG）患者，因精神症状住院后出现呼吸功能恶化。初步诊断考虑肺部感染、误吸和慢阻肺加重，后神经检查发现颜面及球部肌无力加重，伴吞咽困难和无声误吸。动脉血气分析显示慢性高碳酸血症和代谢性碱中毒。基于MG诊断及新出现球部症状，推测球部占优的MG加重可能为呼吸恶化的多因素之一。患者接受静脉免疫球蛋白和激素治疗，呼吸状况稳定但球部功能障碍持续，最终选择临终关怀。研究强调老年MG患者呼吸恶化诊断的复杂性及识别新球部功能障碍的重要性。
keyPoints: 老年肌无力患者呼吸恶化诊断复杂，常见多重病因
新出现的颜面和球部肌无力提示MG球部加重可能
误吸及慢阻肺加重难以排除，多因素参与病情
积极识别球部症状对调整治疗和预后评估重要

intelligence.population: 83岁合并神经肌肉自身免疫病和多重慢性疾病的老年MG患者
intelligence.keyFinding: 球部占优的肌无力加重可能是老年MG患者呼吸功能恶化的多因素之一，需结合肺部及其他系统因素综合评估
intelligence.clinicalImplication: 提示临床应重视老年MG患者呼吸恶化中新出现的球部表现，避免单一归因，合理调整免疫与支持治疗
intelligence.reviewFocus: 全文应关注MG球部加重的诊断标准、误吸与呼吸衰竭的鉴别诊断及治疗反应评估

items.title: Early high-dose intravenous methylprednisolone is associated with faster symptom improvement in persistent ocular myasthenia gravis: a single-center retrospective study.
items.authors: Noritaka Matsuo, Genya Watanabe, Chihiro Sasaki, Ayane Tamagake, Moeko Saito, Kenichi Tsukita
items.abstract: High-dose intravenous methylprednisolone pulse therapy (HMP) may provide rapid symptom relief in ocular myasthenia gravis (MG), but the clinical impact of its early use as induction immunotherapy remains unclear. We evaluated whether early HMP was associated with more rapid symptom improvement in patients with persistent ocular MG. This single-center retrospective study included 36 patients with ocular MG who received corticosteroid-based immunotherapy and remained classified as having ocular MG throughout 2 years of follow-up. Patients were categorized according to their initial immunotherapy strategy into an early HMP induction group ( n = 19), which received HMP at oral prednisolone initiation or within 3 weeks thereafter, and an oral corticosteroid (OCS) induction group ( n = 17), which initially received OCS without HMP. Additional HMP during follow-up was permitted. The primary outcome was the longitudinal change in ocular MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score over 24 months, analyzed using a linear mixed-effects model. Baseline ocular MG-ADL scores were higher in the HMP group (mean ± standard deviation, 4.842 ± 1.642 vs. 3.353 ± 1.057). The mixed-effects model demonstrated a significant group-by-time interaction ( p < 0.001). At 1 month, the least-squares mean ocular MG-ADL score was 0.474 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.024-0.923) in the HMP group and 2.000 (95% CI, 1.525-2.475) in the OCS group, with a significant between-group difference after Tukey adjustment ( p < 0.001). From 3 months onward, scores remained low in both groups without significant between-group differences. The HMP group achieved minimal symptom expression earlier. Oral prednisolone doses and prednisolone-related adverse events did not differ significantly between groups. Initial worsening occurred in two HMP-treated patients, but neither developed myasthenic crisis. In persistent ocular MG, early HMP as part of induction immunotherapy was associated with faster ocular symptom improvement and earlier achievement of minimal symptom expression than OCS induction alone, while long-term clinical outcomes and oral prednisolone doses were similar. Early HMP may be useful when rapid symptom control is required, although prospective studies are needed.
items.zhSummary: 本回顾性单中心研究纳入36例持续性眼肌型重症肌无力患者，比较早期大剂量静脉甲泼尼龙冲击治疗（HMP）与口服皮质激素（OCS）诱导治疗对症状改善速度的影响。研究发现，HMP组在治疗1个月时眼部MG-ADL评分明显低于OCS组，提示早期HMP可更快缓解症状，且早期达到最低症状表达。两组长期（24个月）临床结局及口服泼尼松用量无显著差异。部分HMP患者出现初期症状加重，未发生重症危象。结果支持早期HMP在需要快速控制症状时的潜在价值，但需进一步前瞻性研究验证。

items.title: Extracardiovascular immune-related adverse events in patients with suspected cardiac toxicity associated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
items.authors: François Fer, Francesco Cribari, Soledad Henriquez, Imen Hamdi, Agnès Lillo Le Louet, Christophe Caussin
items.abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer therapy but may cause immune-related adverse events (iRAEs). Cardiovascular iRAEs, especially myocarditis, carry high morbidity and mortality. Extracardiovascular iRAEs are included as diagnostic criteria for myocarditis, yet their prevalence, spectrum, and clinical impact in patients with suspected cardiovascular iRAEs are poorly defined. We conducted a prospective, single-center observational study between March 2022 and December 2023. Consecutive patients referred to cardio-oncology for suspected ICI-related cardiovascular toxicity underwent systematic cardiovascular evaluation, internal medicine assessment, pharmacovigilance review, and multidisciplinary adjudication. Data included cardiovascular and extracardiovascular iRAEs, treatment decisions, and outcomes. Among 208 patients enrolled (median age 60 years; 78% female), 206 completed follow-up. Cardiovascular iRAEs were confirmed in 108 patients, predominantly myocarditis (75%). Extracardiovascular iRAEs occurred in 32% of patients (n = 67; 97 events), most frequently endocrine (57.6%, mainly thyroid), followed by muscular and cutaneous events (each 9.3%). Most extracardiovascular iRAEs were CTCAE grade 2, while severe muscular or neurological toxicities, including myositis and myasthenia gravis, occurred in 1.4%. Myocarditis was more frequent in patients with extracardiovascular iRAEs (57% vs. 34%). In 18 cases, extracardiovascular iRAEs fulfilled IC-OS minor criteria, enabling a definite myocarditis diagnosis. ICIs were discontinued in 56% of patients, with extracardiovascular iRAEs contributing in 15%, and accounted for nearly one-third of indications for immunosuppressive therapy. Mortality was mainly cancer-related. In patients referred for suspected ICI-related cardiovascular toxicity, extracardiovascular iRAEs are frequent and clinically relevant. They contribute to myocarditis diagnosis and management, supporting systematic multidisciplinary cardiology-internal medicine evaluation.
items.zhSummary: 本研究在单中心对208例疑似免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）相关心脏毒性患者进行前瞻性观察，系统评估心血管及心外免疫相关不良事件(iRAEs)。108人确诊心血管iRAEs，主要为心肌炎；32%患者发生心外iRAEs，多为内分泌障碍，严重肌肉神经毒性少见。心肌炎患者中，合并心外iRAEs的比例较高。部分心外iRAEs有助于确诊心肌炎。56%患者停用ICI，15%因心外iRAEs停药，近三分之一需免疫抑制治疗。死亡主要与癌症相关。研究强调心外iRAEs在诊断和管理ICI相关心脏毒性中的价值，支持多学科评估。

items.title: Treg-associated oligomannose N-glycans trigger immune dysregulation in myasthenia gravis.
items.authors: Pedro Carneiro, Manuel M Vicente, Inês Alves, Catarina M Azevedo, Íris Caramalho, Joana Gaifem
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune neurological disease driven by the production of autoantibodies against components of the neuromuscular junction, resulting in fatigable muscle weakness, and in more severe cases, leading to life-threatening complications. This breakdown of immune tolerance has been associated with an impaired suppressive function and altered frequency of Regulatory T cells (Tregs) in autoimmune diseases, including MG. As key regulators of immune tolerance, Tregs play a pivotal role in maintaining immune homeostasis through their ability to suppress other immune cells, controlling inflammation. Nevertheless, the mechanisms underlying Tregs dysfunction in MG pathogenesis are not fully understood. Here, we reveal the impact of Treg N-glycosylation on their immunoregulatory activity and function in the MG context. Glycan profiling by flow cytometry of circulating Tregs from MG patients (n = 72) and healthy controls (HCs; n = 24) revealed increased presence of oligomannose N-glycans in disease. Moreover, this specific Treg N-glycome profile was associated with disease severity, distinguishing between active disease and remission, being more pronounced in MG patients with additional autoimmune diseases, highlighting its potential as a disease biomarker. Functionally, in vitro abrogation of the N-glycosylation pathway in Tregs (mimicking the oligomannose enrichment found in the patients) resulted in impaired suppressive capacity over conventional T cells. Consistently, in the Experimental Autoimmune Myasthenia Gravis (EAMG) model, mice with altered Treg N-glycosylation exhibited worse clinical features and a reduced frequency of effector Tregs compared to wild-type controls. Altogether, these findings identify N-glycosylation as a mechanism underlying Treg dysfunction in MG, in which abnormal expression of mannose-enriched N-glycans in Tregs associates with compromised Treg suppressive function and increased disease severity, proposing Treg N-glycosylation as both a mechanistic driver of MG pathogenesis and a potential avenue for therapeutic intervention.
items.zhSummary: 本研究探讨了重症肌无力（MG）患者调节性T细胞（Tregs）N-糖基化异常与免疫功能失调的关联。通过流式细胞术分析72例MG患者和24例健康对照的循环Tregs糖链，发现MG患者Tregs中寡甘露糖N-糖基化明显增多，且该特征与疾病活动度和合并其他自身免疫病相关。体外抑制Tregs的N-糖基化途径降低其对常规T细胞的抑制功能。在实验性自身免疫性MG小鼠模型中，N-糖基化异常导致临床症状加重和效应Tregs频率下降。研究提示Tregs异常糖基化可能是MG发病机制的一部分，并为治疗提供新思路。

items.title: Co-occurrence of myasthenia gravis and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder: A case series and literature review.
items.authors: Natalia Gómez-Salazar, Paola Andrea Ortíz-Salas, Carlos Alberto Jiménez-Tocasuche, Luis Alexander Granados-Patiño, Harold Styven Basallo, Neiry María Zapa-Pérez
items.abstract: Patients with myasthenia gravis develop other autoimmune diseases in 5-30% of cases and have a higher incidence of demyelinating disorders than the general population. An increased risk of neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder following thymectomy has also been reported. To describe two adult patients from Bogotá, Colombia, with concurrent myasthenia gravis and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder after thymectomy, and to provide a literature review. A retrospective literature review of articles published up to October 2024 was performed using PubMed and Embase with the terms "Neuromyelitis," "Thymectomy," "Myasthenia Gravis," and "Aquaporin 4." Studies in English or Spanish reporting myasthenia gravis and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder were included. Additionally, two adult patients from Bogotá who developed neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder after thymectomy for myasthenia gravis were analyzed. 60 patients were included, comprising 58 cases identified in the literature and 2 additional cases from our center. Two adult patients (one male, one female) previously diagnosed with myasthenia gravis developed neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder symptoms following thymectomy. The literature search yielded 24 articles describing 58 patients, 94.8% were women. Myasthenia gravis preceded neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder in most cases (85.7%). Thymectomy was reported in 39 of 58 patients (67.2%). Among patients in whom thymectomy preceded neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, the mean interval between thymectomy and NMOSD onset was 12.8 ± 9.3 years. Myasthenia gravis and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder coexistence follow a consistent pattern, supporting shared autoimmune susceptibility. Further studies are needed to clarify its clinical implications.
items.zhSummary: 本研究回顾并分析了共计60例重症肌无力（MG）合并视神经脊髓炎谱系障碍（NMOSD）的患者，包括文献中58例和来自哥伦比亚波哥大中心的2例病例。多数患者为女性，MG通常先于NMOSD发病。67.2%的患者曾接受胸腺切除术，术后平均约13年出现NMOSD症状。结果提示MG与NMOSD可能存在共同自身免疫易感性，但其临床意义尚需进一步研究。

items.title: Mitochondrial Myopathy in the Oculoplastic Practice.
items.authors: Alex J Y Cheong, Jianbin Ding, Zhi Wei Lim, Wen Chen, Kong Bing Tan, Maryanne Chew Romero
items.abstract: Ptosis is a common ocular complaint in the elderly population. While most cases are often due to involutional changes in the eyelid, neurogenic, mechanical or myogenic diseases should remain as important differential diagnoses. We report a case of a 75-year-old Chinese man who presented with chronic progressive ptosis and was initially managed as presumed seronegative ocular myasthenia gravis (MG). Despite positive bedside findings suggestive of MG, serological and electrophysiological investigations were inconclusive, and there was no clinical response to pyridostigmine. The diagnosis was achieved only after an opportunistic frontalis muscle biopsy obtained during planned brow lift surgery demonstrated histopathological features supportive of a mitochondrial aetiology. This case highlights the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing mitochondrial myopathies (MM) from ocular MG, emphasises clinical features that should prompt reconsideration of the diagnosis, and illustrates how opportunistic biopsy during oculoplastic surgery may facilitate diagnosis in selected patients with persistent diagnostic uncertainty.
items.zhSummary: 本文报告一例75岁中国男性患者，因慢性进行性眼睑下垂就诊，初步诊断为疑似血清阴性眼肌型重症肌无力(MG)并给予吡啶斯的明治疗无效。详细血清学和电生理检查结果未明确支持MG。最终通过计划行眉提升手术时行额肌活检，病理发现支持线粒体肌病的诊断。该病例反映在鉴别MG与线粒体肌病时的诊断挑战，提示应根据临床特点寻求重新评估诊断，且在眼整形手术中可利用机会活检辅助诊断。

items.title: From Rescue Therapy to Mechanism-Based Sequencing in Refractory Myasthenia Gravis: A Narrative Review with an Illustrative Clinical Case.
items.abstract: Refractory acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis (AChR-Ab-positive gMG) is clinically heterogeneous, and evidence on how to select a therapeutic mechanism after incomplete response to a previous targeted class remains limited. This narrative review synthesizes guidelines, randomized trials, extension studies, meta-analyses, observational evidence, and emerging translational data identified through targeted searches updated to 21 June 2026, with a final bibliographic check through 10 August 2026. We examine conventional immunosuppression, rescue therapy, B-cell and B-lineage depletion, terminal complement inhibition, and neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) inhibition as interventions acting at different levels of the pathogenic cascade. We propose a framework in which prior response, nonresponse, intolerance, corticosteroid dependence, respiratory vulnerability, and rescue-therapy dependence are interpreted as mechanistic clues rather than as a fixed treatment ladder. An illustrative case of severe refractory AChR-Ab-positive gMG showed incomplete control after conventional immunosuppression, rituximab, thymectomy, and terminal complement inhibition, with reproducible but transient benefit from plasma exchange. This pattern supported a mechanistic rationale for FcRn inhibition, although overlapping treatments and single-case design preclude causal attribution. Mechanism-based sequencing should be viewed as structured decision support rather than a validated algorithm. Prospective switching studies and predictive biomarkers are needed to optimize individualized treatment sequencing.
items.zhSummary: 本叙述性综述针对难治性乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性广泛性重症肌无力（AChR-Ab阳性gMG），整合多种证据来源，探讨在既往靶向治疗不完全响应后，如何基于病理机制选择后续治疗策略。梳理了传统免疫抑制、救援治疗、B细胞清除、末端补体抑制及新兴的新生儿Fc受体抑制等多种干预手段。通过一个复杂病例，演示病情难以用单一疗法完全控制，提示机制基础的治疗序列应作为决策支持，而非固定路径。研究强调了前瞻性转换研究和预测性生物标志物的需求，当前证据仍有限，无法确认因果关系。

items.title: Good's syndrome and infections in a large retrospective cohort of thymoma.
items.authors: Wenji Jia, Lei Jin, Xiao Huan, Chong Yan, Jianying Xi, Liewen Pang, Chongbo Zhao, Jie Song, Xianglin Chu, Sushan Luo
items.abstract: Good's syndrome (GS) is an immunodeficiency associated with thymoma characterized by hypogammaglobulinemia. The co-existence of recurrent infections may be associated with quality of life and overall survival. Despite its relevance, the impact of GS on patients with thymoma has rarely been studied in large cohorts. This is a retrospective cohort study of patients with pathologically confirmed thymoma recruited between May 2010 and November 2024. Data on peripheral immune profile, infections, and paraneoplastic syndrome (PNS) were collected and analyzed. Of 1001 patients with thymoma, we ultimately included 158 patients who underwent peripheral immune profiling. The prevalence of GS was 45.6% (72/158), and the infections were reported in 43.69% (69/158). Infection rates were higher in the GS group than in non-GS group (50% versus 32.72%, P = 0.0384). Among the 121 pathogens identified from this cohort, bacteria were the most prevalent (52.07%, 63/121), followed by fungi (34.71%, 42/121) and virus (13.22%, 16/121). Patients with infections had significantly lower overall survival compared with those without infections (P < 0.001). In addition, patients with multiple PNS had poorer survival than those with a single PNS (P < 0.001). No significant difference in overall survival was found between the GS and the non-GS groups. GS and infections are prevalent in patients with thymoma. Infections and multiple PNS were associated with poorer survival outcomes. These findings highlight the importance of early detection and intervention for improving prognosis and long-term survival in patients with thymoma.
